title: Acknowledge where there is no right answer
statement: Answer a prompt that has no right answer with an acknowledgement of what the learner said: nothing prewritten, which can give away what comes, and no correction or next step.
example: When one build's suppression of prewritten replies was disabled on purpose, 5 of its gate's 10 checks went red, including the one for character names leaking.
detail: A Grade 3 reading build opens by asking what the child already knows, before they have read a word, and its reply was assembled from writing prepared in advance that knew the story: it named characters and told the child what happens. A brief version that also showed the marker's suggested next step produced a panel headed 'One more thing' whose one more thing was a direction to start reading, a correction heading delivering a stage direction. The fix prints nothing written in advance on those beats, only an acknowledgement and what the child actually said, and stops there, since the beats have no right answer and so no next step. Its gate passes 10/10, and 5 of its 10 checks went red when the suppression was disabled on purpose.

evidence.quote: it named characters and told the child what happens.
A warm-up meant to find out what a child brings was handing them the plot instead.
a correction heading delivering a stage direction
have no right answer, so there is no next step to give, and the panel now says one thing and stops.
The gate is `no_preview_check`, **10/10**, measured on the build, driven directly, 2026-07-30.
